description: Creates a destination from an RTMP URL and stream key (Twitch, Kick, Facebook, any RTMP server). A stream key backs one destination: the same key again is refused with the existing destination's id. The URL cannot be changed later (remove the destination and create it again); the key can, with destination_update. `rtmpUrl` is shown by destination_list, so the key goes in `rtmpKey`, never in the URL.
name: destination_create_rtmp
title: Create RTMP destination
